question: Thong tu 35/2024/TT-BGTVT quy dinh nhung noi dung gi?
answer_reference: Thong tu quy dinh ve dao tao, sat hach, cap giay phep lai xe; cap, su dung giay phep lai xe quoc te; dao tao, kiem tra, cap chung chi boi duong kien thuc phap luat ve giao thong duong bo.

question: Thoi gian lai xe an toan duoc giai thich nhu the nao?
answer_reference: Thoi gian lai xe an toan la thoi gian nguoi co giay phep lai xe co hieu luc, khong de xay ra tai nan giao thong duong bo gay hau qua nghiem trong hoac dac biet nghiem trong.
expected_contains: khong de xay ra tai nan

question: Thoi gian hoc lai xe ban dem duoc tinh tu may gio den may gio?
answer_reference: Thoi gian hoc lai xe ban dem duoc tinh tu 18 gio ngay hom truoc den 05 gio sang ngay hom sau.

question: Nguoi hoc giay phep lai xe hang A1 co duoc tu hoc ly thuyet khong?
answer_reference: Co. Nguoi hoc hang A1 duoc lua chon tu hoc cac mon ly thuyet hoac hoc tap trung tai co so dao tao; phan thuc hanh hoc tap trung tai co so dao tao.

question: Tong thoi gian dao tao toi thieu doi voi hang A1 la bao nhieu gio?
answer_reference: Tong thoi gian dao tao toi thieu doi voi hang A1 la 12 gio.

question: Hang B1 phai hoc toi thieu bao nhieu gio va bao nhieu kilomet thuc hanh?
answer_reference: Hang B1 co tong thoi gian dao tao 44 gio, so gio thuc hanh lai xe/hoc vien 8 gio va so km thuc hanh lai xe/hoc vien 60 km.

question: Mot xe tap lai hang B1 duoc bo tri toi da bao nhieu hoc vien?
answer_reference: Mot xe tap lai hang B1 duoc bo tri khong qua 05 hoc vien.

question: Hay so sanh hinh thuc dao tao ly thuyet va thuc hanh giua hang A1, A, B1 voi hang B, C1.
answer_reference: Hang A1, A, B1 duoc tu hoc ly thuyet hoac hoc tap trung; thuc hanh tap trung. Hang B, C1 hoc ly thuyet tap trung hoac dao tao tu xa/tu hoc co huong dan; thuc hanh tap trung.

question: Dieu kien de hoc vien hang B1 duoc cong nhan hoan thanh khoa dao tao la gi?
answer_reference: Dieu kien nam tai Dieu 7 khoan 4: hoc vien hang B1 phai kiem tra ly thuyet va thuc hanh, co 100% bai kiem tra ket thuc mon hoc dat tu 5,0 diem tro len.

question: Bao cao dang ky sat hach hang A1 phai duoc gui truoc ky sat hach bao nhieu ngay?
answer_reference: Bao cao dang ky sat hach hang A1 phai gui truoc ky sat hach toi thieu 04 ngay lam viec.

question: Truong hop nguoi dan toc thieu so khong biet doc, viet tieng Viet thi bao cao dang ky sat hach A1 phai gui truoc bao lau?
answer_reference: Truong hop nguoi dan toc thieu so khong biet doc, viet tieng Viet thi bao cao dang ky sat hach A1 gui truoc ky sat hach toi thieu 30 ngay.

question: So Giao thong van tai phai gui bao cao dinh ky sau thang va bao cao nam vao nhung thoi diem nao?
answer_reference: So Giao thong van tai gui bao cao dinh ky 6 thang truoc ngay 20 thang 6 va bao cao nam truoc ngay 20 thang 12.

question: Mot hoc vien thuc hanh lai xe trong mot phien keo dai 4 gio 30 phut. Phien hoc do co duoc ghi nhan khong? Vi sao?
answer_reference: Khong, vi mot phien hoc thuc hanh DAT khong duoc qua 4 gio.

question: Hai phien thuc hanh cua mot hoc vien chi cach nhau 10 phut. Du lieu cua cac phien nay co hop le khong?
answer_reference: Khong hop le, vi khoang cach giua hai phien hoc thuc hanh cua mot hoc vien phai toi thieu 15 phut.

question: Mot phien hoc co ty le xac thuc khuon mat dat 70%. Phien hoc co duoc ghi nhan khong?
answer_reference: Khong, vi ty le xac thuc khuon mat phai dat toi thieu 75%.

question: Hoc vien da hoan thanh 60% thoi gian thuc hanh tren duong nhung chua du so kilomet quy dinh. Nguoi do da hoan thanh noi dung thuc hanh chua?
answer_reference: Chua hoan thanh, vi can du ca thoi gian va so km thuc hanh theo quy dinh.

question: Du lieu ket thuc phien hoc duoc truyen len he thong sau 3 phut. Du lieu co duoc tu dong cong nhan khong va co so dao tao can lam gi?
answer_reference: Khong duoc tu dong cong nhan vi vuot qua 02 phut; co so dao tao phai bao cao So Giao thong van tai.
expected_contains: Khong duoc tu dong cong nhan
bao cao So Giao thong van tai

question: Hay tra loi va ghi ro dieu, khoan quy dinh ve hinh thuc dao tao hang A1.
answer_reference: Quy dinh tai Dieu 5 khoan 1: hang A1 duoc tu hoc ly thuyet hoac hoc tap trung; thuc hanh tap trung tai co so dao tao.

question: Dieu kien hoan thanh khoa dao tao hang B1 nam o dieu nao? Hay trich noi dung quan trong.
answer_reference: Noi dung nam o Dieu 7 khoan 4, yeu cau 100% bai kiem tra ket thuc mon hoc dat tu 5,0 diem tro len.

question: Quy dinh ve thoi luong, khoang cach giua cac phien hoc thuc hanh DAT nam o phan nao cua tai lieu?
answer_reference: Quy dinh nam tai Phu luc XXXXI, phan II, ve thoi luong phien hoc, khoang cach giua phien hoc va dieu kien ghi nhan du lieu.

question: Thong tu nay quy dinh muc phat doi voi nguoi vuot den do la bao nhieu?
answer_reference: Tai lieu khong quy dinh muc phat doi voi nguoi vuot den do, nen khong nen suy doan.

question: Theo tai lieu, le phi cap giay phep lai xe hang B la bao nhieu?
answer_reference: Tai lieu co noi ve viec nop le phi nhung khong quy dinh muc le phi cap giay phep lai xe hang B.

question: Nguoi 16 tuoi co duoc cap giay phep lai xe hang A1 khong?
answer_reference: Khong tim thay can cu trong tai lieu de ket luan nguoi 16 tuoi co duoc cap giay phep lai xe hang A1 hay khong.

question: Hay cho biet gia hoc lai xe hang B tai Ha Noi nam 2026.
answer_reference: Tai lieu khong quy dinh gia hoc lai xe hang B tai Ha Noi nam 2026; day la thong tin ngoai pham vi tai lieu.
